summary: Iovance Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K solely to disclose that it updated its corporate presentation for use at healthcare conferences and with analysts and stockholders. The exhibit is a routine investor presentation containing forward-looking statements, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The filing is purely informational and routine, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions. No special-situation category applies, as this is an ordinary current report updating corporate materials. There is nothing to watch or arbitrage; the event is merely a presentation refresh.
